reuse.why: Re-implements #fixed tag matching with its own regex (with a comment to keep it in step) instead of using extractTagsFromText from shared/tags.ts, and writes the saved-template SQL condition inline although statements.ts and cleanup-template-notes.ts already carry the same template_settings source test; no shared selection is introduced for the month-wide actions.

duplication.why: The month-wide category selection (hidden rule with the include flag, saved-template CASE/NOT clause, #fixed check, income check, notes join) is pasted into six actions, and the new setLastMonthSpending copies it again along with the expense sign flip.

placement.why: Everything stays in budget/actions.ts next to the actions, but the selection rule is spread between per-action SQL and per-action JS loops instead of one helper in the budget layer.

scope.why: The edits cover the four requested steps with tests and the new handler registration; no unrelated changes.

maintainability.why: Each further exclusion rule must be added in six places and in two forms (SQL WHERE for some actions, JS checks for copyPreviousMonth and setZero), so the copies will drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: isFixedGroup in budget/actions.ts re-implements tag parsing instead of calling extractTagsFromText from packages/loot-core/src/shared/tags.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The same exclusion rule is reshaped per action: SQL WHERE clauses with a bound include flag in setLastMonthSpending/set3MonthAvg/set6MonthAvg/set12MonthAvg, a CASE column plus JS checks in setZero and getBudgetData/copyPreviousMonth, with the checks reordered between actions.

abstraction_drift.where: No shared month-wide selection helper exists or is created; copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg each re-implement the hidden/template/#fixed/income selection, and isFixedGroup bypasses shared/tags.ts.
